resources.string: CHORD PROGRESSION GRID (TAP BAR TO AUDITION)
Tap Style, Progression, or Key in the top bar to open the dropdown selector, or use - / + on TEMPO to adjust the backing tempo.
Tap any Bar card in the Chord Progression Grid to audition the chord and cycle through 22 diatonic, dominant 7th, minor 7th, and jazz harmonies.
Tap Kick, Snare, Closed Hat, or Open Hat/Ride cells to toggle OFF -> ON -> ACCENT. Tap Bass cells to cycle chord degrees: Rest (.) -> Root (R) -> 3 -> 5 -> 6 -> b7 -> 8.

Toggle DRUMS / BASS / CHORDS mutes or tap % to cycle volume levels. Tap FILL to queue a drum fill on the next bar, or RST to restore default groove. Solo over the 12-fret guitar neck: GOLD = Key Root, GREEN = Active Chord Root.
